end.summary:
Riya practised examples of diversity in language, food, dress and festivals across India.
They identified shared threads in different forms of Makar Sankranti, including harvest, seasonal change and giving thanks.
They connected clothing choices with regional geography and climate, using phiran in Kashmir and clothing in Kerala as examples.
Riya gave examples of how different people can live together and compared unity in diversity with instruments in a song.
They did not yet pass the teach-back; shared-rule as a common thread needed more explanation.
end.parentNote: Riya practised comparing regional festivals, foods, clothing and languages while looking for shared ideas underneath the differences. They used the method of naming a difference first and then identifying a common thread, such as harvest, seasonal change or giving thanks. Riya mixed up the idea of a shared rule and diversity, and this was not corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, ask them to make a two-column example: “different forms” and “shared idea,” using two festivals.
